VPD Detective's Wife Removed as Council Candidate After Husband's Arrest

Sandy Dosanjh, wife of Vancouver Police Department detective Kalwinder "Kal" Singh Dosanjh, has been removed as a candidate for Surrey City Council in the 2026 municipal election. The Conservative Party of Surrey confirmed her removal from their slate of candidates following her husband's arrest. The coverage does not specify the charges against Kal Dosanjh or the exact date of the arrest.
